div.head: Af 23
div.ab: XXI. Gif hund mon toslite oððe abíte, æt formon mysdæde gesylle VI scll', gif he him mete sylle, æt æfteran cirre XII scll', æt þriddan cirre XXX scll'.
XXI. Gif hund mon toslite oððe abite, æt forman misdæde geselle VI scill., gif he him mete selle, æt æfteran cerre XII scill., æt ðriddan XXX scill.
Si canis hominem desubitet aut mordeat tacitus, in prima culpa reddantur sex solidi, si ei uictum dabit; in secunda uice reddat dominus eius duodecim sol., tertia uice XXX sol.
{XXI} Gif hunde mon toslite oððe abite, æt forman misdæde geselle VI scill; gif he him mete selle, æt æfteran cerre XII scill, æt ðriddan XXX scill.
If a dog gashes or bites someone, at the first misdeed let him pay 6 shillings. If he [continues to] offer it food, at the second offense 12 shillings, at the third 30 shillings.
If a dog tears or bites a man, 6 shillings shall be paid for the first offence. If its owner continues to keep it, 12 shillings shall be paid for the second offence, and 30 shillings for the third.
If a dog rends or bites a man to death, [the owner] is to pay six shillings at the first offence; if he gives it food, he is to pay on a second occasion 12 shillings, on a third 30 shillings.

Wenn ein Hund einen Menschen zerreisst oder todt beisst, zahle [der Herr dem Verletzten] bei der ersten Missethat 6 Schill., wenn er ihm [weiter] Futter giebt, beim zweiten Male 12 Schill., beim dritten 30 Schill.

If a dog tears or bites a person to death, let [the owner] pay [the injured party] 6 shillings for the first misdeed, if he [still] gives it food; the second time 12 shillings; the third, 30 shillings.
